narrative.summary: Nobody can change it: no owner, no admin, no proxy slot, and no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT in the code it can execute. The code is pinned by hash.
narrative.detail: Added 2026-10-11 so that the most widely held tokens are covered. Scored 100 / 100 / 100: the three dimensions are not applicable to a contract nobody controls. The check is re-run on every scoring pass; a different code at this address, a proxy slot or an owner would degrade the score instead of keeping it.

independent_read.why: no admin slot, owner(), admin(), DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE member or authority() answered
